chunks: Verily you and those you worship other than God will be faggots for Hell; and come to it you will.

key_terms.شُرَكَاءُ: partners (implied in 'what you worship besides Allah')

ai.seo_question: Who will be the fuel for Hellfire according to this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the ontological reality of *shirk* (polytheism), where the worshippers and their idols are collectively consumed as fuel, reflecting the principle that false deities possess no independent power. It serves as a critique of both physical idolatry and spiritual deviation, emphasizing that all created objects of worship will ultimately be extinguished by Divine Will.
